_readme: Fill in your real affiliate/partner IDs here once you've signed up for these programs. Nothing in this file is a live affiliate link yet — the placeholders below just get you the correct destination URL per resort; swap in your tracking params after you're approved. See README.md 'Monetization' section for where to apply.

lift_tickets.notes: Liftopia runs an affiliate program (via Impact or similar network). Apply, then set affiliate_param to whatever query param they give you, e.g. '&aff_id=XXXXX'.

gear_rental.notes: evo, Christy Sports, and Ski Butlers all run affiliate programs (commonly via Impact / ShareASale / Awin). Apply and drop your tracking code into affiliate_param.

lodging.notes: Booking.com Affiliate Partner Program (via their own portal) or Expedia's (via Impact/CJ) both work here. Add your aid= param once approved.
